<body>
<!--
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  NOVA HAIR — SALES PAGE (PDP)  ·  Hebrew RTL  ·  Funnelish-ready
  Spine angle: "צובע. מתקן. לא פוגע." (Colors. Repairs. Doesn't damage.)
  Font: Open Sans  ·  Self-contained CSS + JS
  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CHECKOUT LINKS:  search for  data-checkout  — 3 placeholders to swap for
  your real Shopify cart permalinks:  https://YOURSTORE.myshopify.com/cart/VARIANT_ID:QTY
     data-checkout="pack2"  → 2 bottles  ₪189
     data-checkout="pack4"  → 4 bottles  ₪239   (HERO / default)
     data-checkout="pack6"  → 6 bottles  ₪319
  IMAGES: search for  data-img  — labeled placeholders. AI prompts at bottom of file.
  ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-->



<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nova Hair — צובע את השיער ב-10 דקות, ומתקן אותו תוך כדי</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap&subset=hebrew" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ===================== DESIGN SYSTEM ===================== */
.nova, .nova *, .nova *::before, .nova *::after{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  font-family:'Open Sans','Arial Hebrew',Arial,system-ui,sans-serif !important;
  direction:rtl;
}
.nova{
  /* palette — warm hair-care premium */
  --ink:#2B2420;          /* espresso text */
  --ink-soft:#5C5048;
  --ink-mute:#8B7E73;
  --cream:#F7F1EA;        /* page bg */
  --cream-2:#EFE5D8;
  --cream-3:#E4D6C4;      /* borders */
  --bronze:#B26A45;       /* primary accent / CTA */
  --bronze-dk:#8F4F30;
  --bronze-lt:#D89A77;
  --bronze-soft:#F6E3D4;
  --rose:#C98A6D;
  --gold:#C29A4A;
  --green:#5BAA51;
  --green-dk:#41863a;
  --red:#C0392B;
  --blue-verify:#1DA1F2;

  margin:0; padding:0;
  background:var(--cream);
  color:var(--ink);
  font-size:17px;
  line-height:1.6;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
.nova img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.nova .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
.nova .band{padding:58px 0}
.nova h1,.nova h2,.nova h3{margin:0 0 .5em;line-height:1.18;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
.nova h1{font-size:clamp(1.65rem,5.4vw,2.45rem)}
.nova h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,4.8vw,2.1rem)}
.nova h3{font-size:clamp(1.2rem,3.6vw,1.5rem)}
.nova p{margin:0 0 1em}
.nova em{font-style:normal;font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 62%,var(--bronze-soft) 62%);padding:0 3px}
.nova .eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--bronze-dk);
  background:var(--bronze-soft);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:30px;margin-bottom:14px}
.nova .center{text-align:center}

/* buttons */
.nova .btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--bronze) 0%,var(--bronze-dk) 100%);
  color:#fff !important;font-weight:800;font-size:1.1rem;text-decoration:none;
  padding:18px 30px;border:none;border-radius:60px;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 7px 0 #6f3c22, 0 12px 26px rgba(143,79,48,.34);
  transition:transform .12s, box-shadow .12s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:100%}
.nova .btn:hover{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:0 5px 0 #6f3c22,0 8px 16px rgba(143,79,48,.4)}
.nova .btn:active{transform:translateY(5px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #6f3c22}
.nova .btn small{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:.78rem;opacity:.92;margin-top:2px}
.nova .btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;inset-inline-start:-60%;width:40%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent);transform:skewX(-20deg);
  animation:shimmer 4.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes shimmer{0%,55%{inset-inline-start:-60%}100%{inset-inline-start:160%}}

/* scroll reveal */
.nova .rev{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.nova .rev.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ===================== BRAND + TOPBAR ===================== */
.nova .brandbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream-3);text-align:center;padding:12px}
.nova .wordmark{font-weight:800;font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--ink)}
.nova .wordmark b{color:var(--bronze)}
.nova .topbar{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;text-align:center;
  padding:9px 14px;display:flex;gap:18px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nova .topbar span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}
.nova .topbar b{color:var(--gold)}

/* ===================== HERO ===================== */
.nova .hero{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,var(--cream) 100%);padding:34px 0 46px}
.nova .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;align-items:start}
.nova .gal-main{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(43,36,32,.1)}
.nova .thumbs{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
.nova .thumb{width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--cream-3);object-fit:contain;background:#fff;padding:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s}
.nova .thumb.sel{border-color:var(--bronze)}
.nova .hero-offer{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(43,36,32,.09)}
.nova .hero-offer h1{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4.6vw,1.95rem)}
.nova .tagline{font-weight:800;color:var(--bronze-dk);margin:10px 0 12px;font-size:1.02rem}
.nova .qbenefits{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
.nova .qbenefits span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:30px;padding:6px 11px}
.nova .cp-title{font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;margin:16px 0 8px}
.nova .colorpick{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nova .cp{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--cream-3);transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.nova .cp:hover{transform:scale(1.06)}
.nova .cp.sel{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--bronze);transform:scale(1.1)}
.nova .cp-label{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:8px 0 2px}
.nova .cp-label b{color:var(--ink)}
.nova .subtoggle{display:flex;gap:8px;background:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:14px;padding:6px}
.nova .sub-opt{flex:1;border:none;background:transparent;font-family:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-soft);padding:11px 8px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.nova .sub-opt.sel{background:var(--bronze);color:#fff}
.nova .sub-opt i{font-style:normal;font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;opacity:.92}
.nova .sub-perks{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--green-dk);background:#EAF6E8;border:1px solid #BFE3B8;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;margin-top:8px}
.nova .seals{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;justify-content:center}
.nova .seals span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:30px;padding:6px 11px}
.nova .statbar-band{background:var(--ink)}
.nova .statbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:10px;padding:18px 0}
.nova .statbar .stat{flex:1;min-width:110px;text-align:center;color:var(--cream)}
.nova .statbar .stat b{display:block;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.1}
.nova .statbar .stat span{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#E7DBCD}
.nova .giftstack{background:#FFF7E6;border:1px dashed var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-top:6px}
.nova .gs-title{font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;color:#8a6a16;margin-bottom:8px}
.nova .gs-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e8d3a8}
.nova .gs-item b{color:var(--green-dk);font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.nova .gs-item s{color:var(--ink-mute);font-weight:600}
.nova .gs-total{text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:.88rem;color:#8a6a16;margin-top:8px}
.nova .gs-total b{color:var(--green-dk)}
.nova .ratings{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 16px}
.nova .stars{color:var(--gold);font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:1px}
.nova .ratings small{color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600}
.nova .hero-sub{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:20px}
.nova .hero-sub b{color:var(--ink)}
.nova .badges{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.nova .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);
  border-radius:30px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.nova .promise{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#EAF6E8;border:1px solid #BFE3B8;color:var(--green-dk);font-weight:800;font-size:.88rem;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:30px;margin:0 0 14px}

/* image placeholder */
.nova .imgph{background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--cream-2),var(--cream-2) 14px,#e9dccb 14px,#e9dccb 28px);
  border:2px dashed var(--bronze-lt);border-radius:18px;min-height:300px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  text-align:center;color:var(--bronze-dk);font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem;padding:22px;line-height:1.4}
.nova .imgph.tall{min-height:420px}
.nova .imgph.sq{aspect-ratio:1/1;min-height:0}

/* ===================== SECTION: PROBLEM / BLAME ===================== */
.nova .problem{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.nova .problem h2,.nova .problem h3{color:#fff}
.nova .problem em{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 62%,rgba(210,154,119,.4) 62%);color:#fff}
.nova .problem p{color:var(--on-dark,#E7DBCD)}
.nova .blame-line{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,4.4vw,1.8rem);font-weight:800;line-height:1.35;margin:6px 0 18px}
.nova .strike{color:#caa;}

/* ===================== MECHANISM ===================== */
.nova .mech-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:22px;margin-top:24px}
.nova .mech-step{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:16px;padding:22px}
.nova .mech-step .n{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bronze);color:#fff;font-weight:800;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}

/* ===================== BENEFITS GRID ===================== */
.nova .bgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:24px}
.nova .bcard{display:flex;gap:14px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:14px;padding:16px}
.nova .bcard .ic{font-size:1.6rem;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1}
.nova .bcard b{display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.nova .bcard p{margin:0;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ===================== OFFER CARDS ===================== */
.nova .offers{background:var(--cream-2)}
.nova .verified{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#EAF3FF;border:1px solid #BBD9FF;color:#1769c4;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:30px}
.nova .verified .vchk{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#1DA1F2;color:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.66rem}
.nova .optlist{max-width:560px;margin:18px auto 0}
.nova .opt{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 16px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;margin-top:20px}
.nova .opt:hover{border-color:var(--bronze-lt)}
.nova .opt.sel{border-color:var(--bronze);background:var(--bronze-soft)}
.nova .opt .radio{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--cream-3);flex-shrink:0;position:relative}
.nova .opt.sel .radio{border-color:var(--bronze)}
.nova .opt.sel .radio::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bronze)}
.nova .opt .main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.nova .opt .main .t{font-weight:800;font-size:1.06rem;line-height:1.2}
.nova .opt .main .d{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-mute);font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.nova .opt .pr{text-align:left;flex-shrink:0}
.nova .opt .pr .new{font-weight:800;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--ink)}
.nova .opt .pr .old{display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-mute);text-decoration:line-through}
.nova .opt .ribbon2{position:absolute;top:-11px;inset-inline-start:16px;background:var(--bronze);color:#fff;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 12px;border-radius:20px;white-space:nowrap}
.nova .opt .ribbon2.best{background:var(--green)}
.nova .giftbox{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#FFF7E6;border:1px dashed var(--gold);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 15px;margin:18px auto 0;max-width:560px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;color:#8a6a16}
.nova .giftbox .v{margin-inline-start:auto;color:var(--ink-mute);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.nova .authentic{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:560px}
.nova .authentic .ic{font-size:1.5rem;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1}
.nova .authentic b{color:#fff}
.nova .authentic p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:.86rem;color:#E7DBCD;line-height:1.55}
.nova .vrev{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;margin:12px auto 0;max-width:560px;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.5}
.nova .vrev .av{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cream-3);flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--bronze-dk);font-size:.8rem}
.nova .vrev .s{color:var(--gold);font-size:.78rem}
.nova .offer-cta{margin-top:24px}
.nova .stock-meter{margin:8px 0 2px}
.nova .stock-meter .lbl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:6px}
.nova .stock-meter .bar{height:9px;background:var(--cream-3);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.nova .stock-meter .fill{height:100%;width:84%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bronze-lt),var(--red));border-radius:10px}
.nova .trust-row{display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px;font-size:.8rem;
  font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.nova .trust-row span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.nova .countdown{max-width:520px;margin:26px auto 0;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;padding:11px 14px;border-radius:12px}
.nova .countdown b{color:var(--gold);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.nova .paylogos{text-align:center;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--ink-mute);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;margin-top:10px}

/* ===================== COLOR SWATCHES ===================== */
.nova .swatches{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}
.nova .sw{text-align:center;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.nova .sw i{display:block;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 6px;border:3px solid #fff;
  box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}

/* ===================== BEFORE/AFTER ===================== */
.nova .ba-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:24px}
.nova .ba{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}
.nova .ba img{width:100%;display:block;height:auto}
.nova .ba .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.nova .ba .split .imgph{border:none;border-radius:0;min-height:230px}
.nova .ba .lab{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 14px;font-size:.84rem;font-weight:700}
.nova .ba .lab .before{color:var(--red)}
.nova .ba .lab .after{color:var(--green-dk)}

/* ===================== INGREDIENTS ===================== */
.nova .ing-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:24px}
.nova .ing{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cream-3);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}
.nova .ing .imgph{border:none;border-radius:0;min-height:160px}
.nova .ing-img{width:100%;height:180px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;display:block;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream-2)}
.nova .ing .body{padding:18px}
.nova .ing .body h3{margin-bottom:4px}
.nova .ing .lat{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-mute);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:8px}
.nova .ing .body p{margin:0;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* ===================== COMPARISON TABLE ===================== */
.nova .cmp-wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin-top:24px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.nova table.cmp{border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;width:100%;min-width:560px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(43,36,32,.09)}
.nova table.cmp th,.nova table.cmp td{padding:15px 12px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cream-2);font-size:.9rem}
.nova table.cmp thead th{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.86rem}
.nova table.cmp thead th.us{background:var(--bronze);font-size:.95rem}
.nova table.cmp tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.nova table.cmp tbody td:first-child{text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);background:var(--cream)}
.nova table.cmp td.us{background:var(--bronze-soft);font-weight:800}
.nova table.cmp tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child):not(.us){background:#fcfaf7}
.nova .yes{color:var(--green-dk);font-weight:800}
.nova .no{color:var(--red);font-weight:800}

/* ===================== TESTIMONIALS (WhatsApp) ===================== */
.nova .wa{max-width:540px;margin:26px auto 0}
.nova .wa-msg{margin-bottom:18px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.08);background:#fff}
.nova .wa-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#075E54;color:#fff;padding:11px 14px}
.nova .wa-head .av{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:#0c8a7d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:.9rem;flex-shrink:0}
.nova .wa-head b{font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.15}
.nova .wa-head small{display:block;font-size:.72rem;opacity:.85}
.nova .wa-head .vbadge{background:#1DA1F2;color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:2px 9px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;margin-inline-start:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.nova .wa-body{background:#ECE5DD;padding:16px}
.nova .wa-bubble{background:#fff;border-radius:4px 12px 12px 12px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.65;box-shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
.nova .wa-bubble b{color:var(--ink)}
.nova .wa-time{display:block;text-align:left;font-size:.68rem;color:#5a6b6a;margin-top:7px}
.nova .vbadge{color:var(--blue-verify);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700}

/* ===================== SYMPTOM CHECKLIST ===================== */
.nova .checklist{background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream)}
.nova .checklist h2{color:#fff}
.nova .checklist .items{max-width:620px;margin:24px auto 0}
.nova .chk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}
.nova .chk:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.nova .chk .box{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid var(--bronze-lt);flex-shrink:0;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;color:transparent;transition:.15s}
.nova .chk.on .box{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}

  var GIFT_IMG='https://cf.cjdropshipping.com/20200920/1997292181590.jpg';

  var cta=document.getElementById('mainCheckout');
  var ctaSub=document.getElementById('ctaSub');
  var stickyPrice=document.getElementById('stickyPrice');
  var stickyCta=document.getElementById('stickyCta');
  var colorName=document.getElementById('colorName');
  var subPerks=document.getElementById('subPerks');
  var curPack='pack4', curColor='black', curMode='once';

  function fmt(n){ var s=(Math.round(n*100)/100).toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/,'').replace(/(\.\d)0$/,'$1'); return '₪'+s; }
  function effPrice(pack){ var p=FUNNEL.packs[pack].price; return curMode==='sub' ? p*0.8 : p; }

  function refreshTexts(){
    var p=FUNNEL.packs[curPack], eff=effPrice(curPack);
    var subTxt=p.label+' · '+fmt(eff)+' · משלוח חינם'+(curMode==='sub'?' · מנוי':'');
    ctaSub.textContent=subTxt;
    stickyPrice.textContent=fmt(eff)+' · '+p.label;
    var sf=document.getElementById('subFreq'); if(sf) sf.textContent=FUNNEL.freq[curPack];
    /* price cards reflect sub discount */
    root.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(function(o){
      var k=o.getAttribute('data-offer'), pk=FUNNEL.packs[k]; if(!pk) return;
      var nw=o.querySelector('.new'); if(nw) nw.textContent=fmt(curMode==='sub'?pk.price*0.8:pk.price);
    });
  }
  function selectMode(mode){
    curMode=mode;
    root.querySelectorAll('.sub-opt').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('sel',b.getAttribute('data-sub')===mode);});
    if(subPerks) subPerks.style.display=(mode==='sub')?'block':'none';
    refreshTexts();
  }
  function selectPack(pack){
    curPack=pack;
    root.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(function(o){o.classList.toggle('sel',o.getAttribute('data-offer')===pack);});
    refreshTexts();
  }
  function selectColor(color,name){
    curColor=color;
    root.querySelectorAll('.cp').forEach(function(c){c.classList.toggle('sel',c.getAttribute('data-color')===color);});
    if(colorName&&name) colorName.textContent=name;
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(function(o){o.addEventListener('click',function(){selectPack(o.getAttribute('data-offer'));});});
  root.querySelectorAll('.cp').forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('click',function(){selectColor(c.getAttribute('data-color'),c.getAttribute('data-name'));});});
  root.querySelectorAll('.sub-opt').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){selectMode(b.getAttribute('data-sub'));});});

  /* ===== sidecart logic ===== */
  var fsCart=document.getElementById('fsCart'), fsOverlay=document.getElementById('fsOverlay'),
      fsItems=document.getElementById('fsItems'), fsTotal=document.getElementById('fsTotal'),
      fsBumpChk=document.getElementById('fsBumpChk'), fsCtaSub=document.getElementById('fsCtaSub');
  function fsOpen(){ fsCart.classList.add('open'); fsOverlay.classList.add('open'); fsCart.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false'); document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden'; }
  function fsClose(){ fsCart.classList.remove('open'); fsOverlay.classList.remove('open'); fsCart.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); document.documentElement.style.overflow=''; }
  fsOverlay.addEventListener('click',fsClose);
  document.getElementById('fsClose').addEventListener('click',fsClose);

  function displayName(it){
    var vid=it.variant_id;
    if(vid===FUNNEL.gift) return {t:'ערכת צביעה מקצועית',v:'מסרק · כפפות · קליפים',gift:true};
    if(vid===FUNNEL.bump) return {t:'הקפצת ההזמנה לראש התור',v:'אריזה ושילוח בעדיפות',bump:true};
    var vt=(it.variant_title||'').replace(/\s*\/\s*/g,' · ');
    var sub=it.selling_plan_allocation? ' · מנוי ('+ (it.selling_plan_allocation.selling_plan.name||'') .replace('מנוי — ','מנוי ') +')':'';
    return {t:'NOVAHAIR — שמפו צבע מעצב',v:vt+sub};
  }
  function itemPrice(it){
    var base=PRICE_ILS[it.variant_id];
    if(base===undefined) base=it.final_price/100;
    if(it.selling_plan_allocation) base=base*0.8;
    return base;
  }
  function renderFs(cart){
    if(!cart||!cart.items||!cart.items.length){
      fsItems.innerHTML='<div class="fs-empty">הסל ריק — בחרי חבילה כדי להתחיל</div>';
      fsTotal.textContent=fmt(0); fsCtaSub.textContent='';
      fsBumpChk.checked=false;
      return;
    }
    var html='', total=0, hasBump=false;
    cart.items.forEach(function(it){
      var pr=itemPrice(it), line=pr*it.quantity; total+=line;
      var nm=displayName(it);
      if(it.variant_id===FUNNEL.bump) hasBump=true;
      var img=it.image || (nm.gift?GIFT_IMG:FALLBACK_IMG);
      var isFixed=nm.gift||nm.bump;
      html+='<div class="fs-item">'
        +'<img src="'+img+'" alt="" loading="lazy">'
        +'<div class="fs-item-mid"><div class="fs-item-t">'+nm.t+'</div><div class="fs-item-v">'+nm.v+'</div>'
        +(nm.gift?'<span class="fs-item-gift">מתנה בהזמנה</span>':'')
        +'</div><div class="fs-item-side">'
        +'<div class="fs-item-p">'+(nm.gift?'<s>₪49</s> חינם':fmt(line))+'</div>'
        +(isFixed
          ? (nm.bump?'':'')
          : '<div class="fs-qty"><button type="button" data-k="'+it.key+'" data-q="'+(it.quantity-1)+'">−</button><span>'+it.quantity+'</span><button type="button" data-k="'+it.key+'" data-q="'+(it.quantity+1)+'">+</button></div>')
        +(nm.gift?'':'<button type="button" class="fs-rm" data-k="'+it.key+'" data-q="0">הסרה</button>')
        +'</div></div>';
    });
    fsItems.innerHTML=html;
    fsItems.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(function(im){im.addEventListener('error',function(){ if(im.src!==FALLBACK_IMG) im.src=FALLBACK_IMG; });});
    fsTotal.textContent=fmt(total);
    fsCtaSub.textContent=fmt(total)+' · משלוח חינם';
    fsBumpChk.checked=hasBump;
    fsItems.querySelectorAll('button[data-k]').forEach(function(b){
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ changeLine(b.getAttribute('data-k'), parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-q'),10)); });
    });
  }
  function fetchCart(){ return fetch('/cart.js',{headers:{'Accept':'application/json'}}).then(function(r){return r.json();}); }
  function changeLine(key,qty){
    fsItems.style.opacity=.5;
    fetch('/cart/change.js',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({id:key,quantity:qty})})
      .then(function(){ return fetchCart(); })
      .then(function(c){ fsItems.style.opacity=1; renderFs(c); });
  }
  var bumpBusy=false;
  fsBumpChk.addEventListener('change',function(){
    if(bumpBusy) return; bumpBusy=true;
    var p = fsBumpChk.checked
      ? fetch('/cart/add.js',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({items:[{id:FUNNEL.bump,quantity:1}]})})
      : fetchCart().then(function(c){
          var it=c.items.filter(function(i){return i.variant_id===FUNNEL.bump;})[0];
          return it? fetch('/cart/change.js',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({id:it.key,quantity:0})}):null;
        });
    Promise.resolve(p).then(function(){return fetchCart();}).then(function(c){ bumpBusy=false; renderFs(c); });
  });

  var buying=false;
  function buy(e){
    if(e) e.preventDefault();
    if(buying) return; buying=true;
    var oldCta=cta.innerHTML;
    cta.style.opacity=.7;
    fsItems.innerHTML='<div class="fs-skel"></div><div class="fs-skel"></div>';
    fsOpen();
    var main={id:FUNNEL.variants[curPack][curColor],quantity:1};
    if(curMode==='sub') main.selling_plan=FUNNEL.plans[curPack];
    var items=[main,{id:FUNNEL.gift,quantity:1}];
    fetch('/cart/add.js',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({items:items})})
      .then(function(){ return fetchCart(); })
      .then(function(c){ buying=false; cta.style.opacity=1; renderFs(c); })
      .catch(function(){ buying=false; cta.style.opacity=1; fsItems.innerHTML='<div class="fs-empty">משהו השתבש — נסי שוב</div>'; });
  }
  cta.addEventListener('click',buy);
  if(stickyCta) stickyCta.addEventListener('click',buy);

  selectPack('pack4'); selectColor('black','שחור'); selectMode('once');

  /* launch-price countdown (resets so it never shows 00:00) */
  var cd=document.getElementById('countdown');
  if(cd){var cdb=cd.querySelector('b'),t=15*60-1;
    setInterval(function(){t--;if(t<0)t=15*60;var m=Math.floor(t/60),s=t%60;cdb.textContent=m+':'+(s<10?'0':'')+s;},1000);}

  /* checklist + sting */
  var checks=root.querySelectorAll('.chk'), sting=document.getElementById('sting');
  function tally(){var n=0;checks.forEach(function(c){if(c.classList.contains('on'))n++;});sting.classList.toggle('hot',n>=3);}
  checks.forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener('click',function(){c.classList.toggle('on');tally();});});

  /* FAQ accordion */
  root.querySelectorAll('.qa .q').forEach(function(q){
    q.addEventListener('click',function(){q.parentElement.classList.toggle('open');});
  });

  /* gallery — click thumbnail to swap main image */
  var galMain=document.getElementById('galMain');
  root.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach(function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click',function(){
      root.querySelectorAll('.thumb').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('sel');});
      t.classList.add('sel'); if(galMain) galMain.src=t.src;
    });
  });
})();
</script>
